context.noTicketsForClient: This client has no tickets yet.

login.headline: Continuity isn't luck. It's orchestration.
login.sub: MDS is now a menu-driven panel — no more terminal commands. Pick a task, fill in what the environment already knows, and let us handle the orchestration.
login.enterLede: Use your Maxinst corporate Microsoft account to continue.
login.itSupport: Trouble signing in? Contact the IT team.

clients.heading: Select the client
clients.intro: Each client has its own tickets and Maximo/MAS environments. Pick one to start — you can switch at any time from the header.
clients.noneFoundHint: Check the search term, or ask the IT team for access to the client.

home.noTasksFound: No tasks found for this search.

activity.heading: Recent Activity
activity.emptyDesc: Run a task and it shows up here.

tickets.heading: Tickets
tickets.intro: Each ticket isolates its own working folder in MDS. Choose an active ticket — the panel's tasks pick up that context automatically, without asking for the number every time.

environments.heading: Environments
environments.intro: Each environment is a different Maximo/MAS connection. Register it once here and choose which ticket uses which — no longer needed at login.
environments.confirmRemove: Remove this environment? Tickets pointing to it will show "environment removed".
environments.confirmRemoveMessage: {{name}} leaves this client's list. Tickets pointing to it will show "environment removed".

files.heading: Ticket files
files.introEditor: File editor for <1>{{ticket}}</1> — click a file on the left to open it.
files.introList: Select .dbc/.sql files from <1>{{ticket}}</1> to validate or run in batch, without opening the editor.
files.emptyListDesc: Run a task that generates or downloads .dbc/.sql files so you can validate or run them in batch here.

runQueue.heading: Run Queue
runQueue.intro: Select files from <1>{{ticket}}</1>, order the sequence, and run everything at once — no paths to type.
runQueue.workspaceNotice: Files stay in the workspace for versioning via Bitbucket.
runQueue.noErrorLog: No error log recorded for this run.
runQueue.noHistoryDesc: Run a task or a batch action to see the history here.

taskDrawer.noFields: This task needs no parameters — it runs directly against the active ticket.
taskDrawer.noOutput: Run completed — this task produces no output file.

fields.noResults: No results in the connected environment.
fields.filePickerEmptyDesc: Run an extraction or generation task to create {{kind}}files before choosing one here.
fields.noScreenExtractionTitle: No screen extraction found in local directory.
fields.noScreenExtractionDesc: Please perform a screen extraction before generating the difference.

ideToolbar.generateDbcTitle: Converts everything in autoscripts/ into a single .dbc
ideToolbar.selectFileToOpen: Select a file in the tree to open it.
ideToolbar.downloadPackage: Download the package from the <tickets>Tickets</tickets> or <environments>Environments</environments> screen.

fileTree.title: Files
fileTree.confirmDeleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete the file {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.
fileTree.errorEmpty: Enter a name for the file.
fileTree.errorInvalidChars: The name cannot contain / \\ : * ? \" < > | or leading/trailing spaces.
fileTree.errorExists: A file with this name already exists in this folder.

environmentModal.appUserHint: Username only — the password stays in the container's .credentials.env.

newTicketModal.title: Create new ticket
newTicketModal.subtitle: Creates the MDS project folder structure for this ticket.

queue.sourceEmpty: No file generated in this ticket yet — run a task first.
queue.emptyQueue: No file selected yet — check files on the left to build the queue.

apply-presentation-diff.label: Apply Screen Difference
apply-presentation-diff.detail: Applies the screen diff (.mxs) on top of the current screen.

download-autoscripts.label: Download Automation Scripts
download-autoscripts.detail: Extracts one or more automation scripts from the environment to the local project.

extract-action-group.label: Extract Action Group
extract-action-group.detail: Generates a .dbc with one or more action groups.

extract-actions.label: Extract Actions
extract-actions.detail: Generates a .dbc with one or more actions.

extract-app.label: Extract Application
extract-app.detail: Extracts all artifacts of an application.

extract-attributes.label: Extract Attributes
extract-attributes.detail: Extracts database attributes and related configuration (LookupMaps, indexes).

extract-birt-reports.label: Extract BIRT Reports
extract-birt-reports.detail: Extracts a specific BIRT report from an application.

extract-comm-template.label: Extract Communication Template
extract-comm-template.detail: Extracts one or more communication templates.

extract-conditional-expression.label: Extract Conditional Expression
extract-conditional-expression.detail: Extracts conditional expressions from the environment.

extract-conditional-properties.label: Extract Conditional Properties
extract-conditional-properties.detail: Extracts conditional properties linked to an advanced signature.

extract-global-restriction.label: Extract Global Restriction
extract-global-restriction.detail: Extracts the global restriction by application, object, and attribute.

extract-indexes.label: Extract Indexes
extract-indexes.detail: Extracts database indexes for a specific object.

indexes.label: Indexes
indexes.hint: Leave blank to extract all indexes for the object.

extract-menu.label: Extract Menu
extract-menu.detail: Extracts menus created for an application.

extract-mif-object-structure.label: Extract Object Structure
extract-mif-object-structure.detail: Extracts one or more MIF object structures.

extract-mif-endpoint.label: Extract End Point
extract-mif-endpoint.detail: Extracts one or more MIF end points.

extract-mif-web-service.label: Extract Web Service
extract-mif-web-service.detail: Extracts one or more MIF web services.

extract-mif-enterprise-service.label: Extract Enterprise Service
extract-mif-enterprise-service.detail: Extracts one or more MIF enterprise services.

extract-mif-external-system.label: Extract External System
extract-mif-external-system.detail: Extracts one or more MIF external systems.

extract-mif-publish-channel.label: Extract Publish Channel
extract-mif-publish-channel.detail: Extracts one or more MIF publish channels.

extract-mif-invoke-channel.label: Extract Invoke Channel
extract-mif-invoke-channel.detail: Extracts one or more MIF invoke channels.

extract-mif-oslc-resources.label: Extract OSLC Resources
extract-mif-oslc-resources.detail: Extracts one or more MIF OSLC resources.

extract-mif-json-resources.label: Extract JSON Resources
extract-mif-json-resources.detail: Extracts one or more MIF JSON resources.

extract-person-groups.label: Extract Person Groups
extract-person-groups.detail: Extracts one or more Person Groups.

extract-presentation.label: Extract Screen
extract-presentation.detail: Extracts the screen XML for one or more applications.

extract-relationships.label: Extract Relationships
extract-relationships.detail: Extracts relationships for a parent object.

relationships.label: Relationships
relationships.hint: Leave blank to extract all relationships for the object.

extract-security-group.label: Extract Security Group
extract-security-group.detail: Extracts one or more security groups.

extract-signature-options.label: Extract Advanced Signature
extract-signature-options.detail: Extracts the advanced signature (sigoptions) for an application.

extract-start-center.label: Extract Start Center
extract-start-center.detail: Extracts one or more Start Centers.

extract-system-properties.label: Extract System Properties
extract-system-properties.detail: Extracts one or more system properties.

extract-tables.label: Extract Tables
extract-tables.detail: Extracts one or more tables, along with relationships and indexes.

extract-messages.label: Extract Messages
extract-messages.detail: Extracts messages from a specific group.

keys.label: Message keys
keys.hint: Leave blank to extract all messages in the group.

generate-dbc-autoscript.label: Generate Automation DBC
generate-dbc-autoscript.detail: Converts all scripts in the local autoscripts folder into a single .dbc file.

generate-new-ticket.label: Generate New Ticket
generate-new-ticket.detail: Creates the project folder structure for a new ticket.

generate-package.label: Generate Package
generate-package.detail: Creates the complete package with all artifacts for installation.

generate-presentation-diff.label: Generate Screen Difference
generate-presentation-diff.detail: Creates .mxs files from the presentations/original and presentations/changes folders.

apps.label: Applications
apps.hint: Only apps with a screen extraction in this ticket appear here. Leave blank to include all.

generate-tech-document.label: Generate Technical Document
generate-tech-document.detail: Generates the project's technical documentation from the active ticket.

import-birt-reports.label: Import BIRT Reports
import-birt-reports.detail: Imports a specific BIRT report into the given application.

run-script-file.label: Run .dbc/.sql on Maximo
run-script-file.detail: Runs the selected .dbc/.sql file inside the MDS container.

update-autoscript.label: Update Automation Script
update-autoscript.detail: Uploads the local version of an automation script to the environment.

update-remote-ticket.label: Update Remote Ticket
update-remote-ticket.detail: Syncs the entire active ticket project with the remote repository.

validate-dbc-file.label: Validate DBC File
validate-dbc-file.detail: Validates one or more already-generated .dbc files and reports any errors found.
